items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: Fan, Fan have played with us.

ctx.x: Yeah, I can't remember those two guys' names. Only three of the guys I remember. It was Peter, Kid George, and, yeah. And where we had, you see, we had Fan playing piano. Fan, I can't think of that boy's name. He plays a banjo. You know Fan? Well, Fan, Fan have played with us.
